text:
Lena M: Final draft uploaded — need quick lane checks before I lock: 1) headline final, 2) benchmark wording & numbers, 3) webinar CTA + inbound routing. Doc: https://doc.redwood/example.

Diego R: Quick skim 2: headline idea: 'Ship with confidence: predictable latency, predictable costs' but concise. Benchmarks: prefer explicit numbers + test conditions. e.g., 'median generation 210ms, p95 480ms at 1k tokens (A100s, batch=8)'.

Priya S: legal note: can't say "data never leaves our servers". Please change to: "data storage and processing options include hosted and dedicated deployments; customers control data residency." Also need the eval artifact uploaded to the legal folder before publish.

Lena M: will swap the residency sentence to Priya's phrasing. Diego's benchmark line makes sense 2: I'll add `(A100, batch=8)` to be specific.

Noah T: product nit: add one line in the hero that highlights rollout controls (pin model versions + canary rollback). Helps PMs understand ops benefits. Also request a one-sentence comparison box: Hosted vs Dedicated (2 bullets).

Zoe K: quote from CTO for the hero: "Making inference operationally predictable unlocks product velocity." Use credit: "— Amir, CTO".

Lena M: thanks Zoe. Webinar CTA draft: 'Register for our launch webinar to see a live demo, ask the team questions, and receive the full eval.' Should the CTA point to webinar or to blog + inline form?

Diego R: recommend CTAs: primary = blog with inline form (collect signups), secondary = 'watch webinar' for recorded replay. Add checkbox `wants_eval` on form.

Priya S: legal approves the revised residency phrasing and the CTO quote. Reminder: attach the eval report PDF and the internal eval spreadsheet to the audit drive and link them in the doc.

Lena M: inbound mapping proposal: HubSpot form fields -> list: "2026_launch_blog", tags: ["source:blog","interest:benchmarks"], hidden fields: `campaign=prod_launch_2026`, `channel=organic`. Form checkbox `wants_eval` triggers automated delivery.

ops-bot: Ops note: scheduling publish + webinar same day is ok but increases support load. Recommend publish Tuesday 09:00 PT, webinar Thursday 10:00 PT. HubSpot form created at: https://hubspot.forms/test-form-1990. Workflow will attach S3 eval link when `wants_eval=true`.

Noah T: product sign-off on benchmark phrasing. Add alt text to hero: 'Redwood Inference platform UI'.

Priya S: legal sign-off pending upload of eval artifacts. Once assets are in audit drive, legal OK to proceed.

Lena M: I'll upload eval now and update the doc with the S3 link. Also updating hero alt. If legal + product + ops confirm I will ask publish-bot to schedule.

Diego R: approving content, fine with the A100/batch detail.

Priya S: artifact uploaded to /legal/audit/2026_launch_eval.pdf. Legal sign-off confirmed.

Lena M: great. @publish-bot please schedule CMS publish for 2026-05-12T09:00:00-07:00 and configure webhook to HubSpot form https://hubspot.forms/test-form-1990. Include hidden fields mapping and the `wants_eval` workflow.

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post 'Ship with confidence: predictable latency, predictable costs' set to publish 2026-05-12 09:00 PDT. HubSpot webhook configured; workflow for eval delivery created.

Lena M: final checklist: hero alt updated, CTO quote in place, eval linked, HubSpot mapping + workflow live. If no objections I'll press publish on Tuesday. :rocket:
